protocol.py: 11 biology problems (3 errors, 6 warnings, 2 notes).

1. ERROR SOURCE-TOO-SHALLOW: The pipette draws air from well A1 in slot 5: the liquid is
below the tip
   line 97:  p300.aspirate(add_vol, dms0_reservoir["A1"])
   At line 97 the p300_single_gen2 draws 60 ul from dmso (well A1 in slot 5) with its tip 1
   mm above the bottom of the well. By then the well holds 160 ul, which in this NEST 12
   Well Reservoir 15 mL reaches only 0.79 mm up: the tip is above the liquid and draws air
   (this line did it 6 times, after 14 times in the liquid; 360 ul of air in all). The
   simulator does not notice: it does not follow the liquid. The 6 wells filled from these
   draws got air instead of liquid.
   Affected: well A1 in slot 5.
   Also reached 6 other wells: wells C6, D2, D3, D4, D5 and D6 in slot 3.
   Fix: Keep the liquid above the tip. This well needs about 258 ul in it for the surface to
   reach 1 mm. Load that much more than the run draws; or draw from a smaller vessel (a tube
   lifts the liquid); or aspirate lower with `well.bottom(0.5)`.
   Source: Opentrons: liquid control (aspirates 1 mm above the bottom of the well by
   default)
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/basic_commands/liquids.html
   Source: Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error
           https://www.bioprocessintl.com/assays/automated-liquid-handlers-as-sources-of-error
   Source: Gilson guide to pipetting (immersion depth 2 to 3 mm for 1 to 100 ul)
           https://solutions.pipette.com/wp-content/uploads/Gilson-Guide-to-Pipetting.pdf
   Source: labautomation.io 7592: negative controls positive after aspirating air
           https://labautomation.io/t/aspiration-dispense-liquid-class-incompatibity/7592
   Source: Integra: 260 ul dead volume in a standard reservoir
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applications/minimizing-dead-volume-during-qpcr-set-divided-reservoir-assist-plus-pipetting-robot
   [f77953da9208]

2. ERROR PIPETTE-RANGE: 10 ul is below what the p300_single_gen2 can measure (20 ul at
least)
   line 112:  p300.mix(volume=10, repetitions=3)
   At line 112 the p300_single_gen2 is asked to draw 10 ul, below its minimum of 20 ul (this
   line did it 72 times). A pipette cannot measure less than its minimum: it draws the wrong
   amount, or nothing, and the volumes in this protocol only add up on paper. The simulator
   passes the move. Wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2 and 16 more in slot 3.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2 and 16 more in slot 3.
   Fix: Use a pipette whose range covers the volume (a p20 for 1 to 20 ul), or scale the
   reaction so every volume is at least the pipette's minimum.
   Source: Opentrons: pipette characteristics (volume ranges)
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/pipettes/characteristics.html
   Source: Integra: pipetting tips (work at 35 to 100% of nominal volume)
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/united-states/en/pipetting-tips
   [8d33de87d00c]

3. ERROR PIPETTE-RANGE: 10 ul is below what the p300_single_gen2 can measure (20 ul at
least)
   line 122:  p300.aspirate(10, source_plate[well_name])
   At line 122 the p300_single_gen2 is asked to draw 10 ul, below its minimum of 20 ul (this
   line did it 24 times). A pipette cannot measure less than its minimum: it draws the wrong
   amount, or nothing, and the volumes in this protocol only add up on paper. The simulator
   passes the move. Wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2 and 16 more in slot 3.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2 and 16 more in slot 3.
   Fix: Use a pipette whose range covers the volume (a p20 for 1 to 20 ul), or scale the
   reaction so every volume is at least the pipette's minimum.
   Source: Opentrons: pipette characteristics (volume ranges)
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/pipettes/characteristics.html
   Source: Integra: pipetting tips (work at 35 to 100% of nominal volume)
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/united-states/en/pipetting-tips
   [8e3bfae91d11]

4. WARNING CONTAM-STOCK: A used tip went into a stock: dmso (well A1 in slot 5)
   line 97:  p300.aspirate(add_vol, dms0_reservoir["A1"])
   At line 97 the tip went into dmso (well A1 in slot 5) while it still carried compound 1
   (tube A1 in slot 2), compound 2 (tube A2 in slot 2) and compound 3 (tube A3 in slot 2)
   from an earlier step (this line did it 3 times). A tip that has touched one liquid leaves
   a little of it in the next liquid it touches, so this stock now holds material that does
   not belong there. The protocol drew from it again afterwards, but only into wells that
   were given that material on purpose anyway, so this run is not harmed. What is left in
   the stock is no longer clean for the next run.
   Affected: well A1 in slot 5.
   Fix: Pick up a fresh tip before line 97 goes into the stock. Or change the order: hand
   out the shared liquid first, while the tip is still clean, and add the other liquids
   afterwards with a fresh tip each.
   Source: Lab Manager: minimizing cross-contamination in automated liquid handling
           https://www.labmanager.com/minimizing-cross-contamination-in-automated-liquid-handling-workflows-35194
   Source: WHO: dos and don'ts for molecular testing
           https://www.who.int/teams/global-malaria-programme/case-management/diagnosis/nucleic-acid-amplification-based-diagnostics/dos-and-don-ts-for-molecular-testing
   [7d598e299efd]

   Fix: Pick up a fresh tip before line 103 goes into the stock. Or change the order: hand

   Source: Lab Manager: minimizing cross-contamination in automated liquid handling

6. WARNING MIX-TOO-WEAK: Mixing too weak to stir 23 wells: 3 × 10 ul in 30 to 90 ul
   line 112:  p300.mix(volume=10, repetitions=3)
   At line 112 the tip mixes wells A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2, B3 and 15 more in slot 3 with
   3 strokes of 10 ul in a well holding 30 to 90 ul (this line did it 23 times). 3 strokes
   of 10 ul move 0.33 to 1 of the well in all; it takes about 2 wells' worth of strokes to
   mix (the mixing work). Integra draws over 80% of the well five times; three mixes gave

findings.title: The pipette draws air from well A1 in slot 5: the liquid is below the tip
findings.explanation: At line 97 the p300_single_gen2 draws 60 ul from dmso (well A1 in slot 5) with its tip 1 mm above the bottom of the well. By then the well holds 160 ul, which in this NEST 12 Well Reservoir 15 mL reaches only 0.79 mm up: the tip is above the liquid and draws air (this line did it 6 times, after 14 times in the liquid; 360 ul of air in all). The simulator does not notice: it does not follow the liquid. The 6 wells filled from these draws got air instead of liquid.
findings.fix: Keep the liquid above the tip. This well needs about 258 ul in it for the surface to reach 1 mm. Load that much more than the run draws; or draw from a smaller vessel (a tube lifts the liquid); or aspirate lower with `well.bottom(0.5)`.

findings.title: 10 ul is below what the p300_single_gen2 can measure (20 ul at least)
findings.explanation: At line 112 the p300_single_gen2 is asked to draw 10 ul, below its minimum of 20 ul (this line did it 72 times). A pipette cannot measure less than its minimum: it draws the wrong amount, or nothing, and the volumes in this protocol only add up on paper. The simulator passes the move. Wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2 and 16 more in slot 3.
findings.fix: Use a pipette whose range covers the volume (a p20 for 1 to 20 ul), or scale the reaction so every volume is at least the pipette's minimum.

findings.title: A used tip went into a stock: dmso (well A1 in slot 5)
findings.explanation: At line 97 the tip went into dmso (well A1 in slot 5) while it still carried compound 1 (tube A1 in slot 2), compound 2 (tube A2 in slot 2) and compound 3 (tube A3 in slot 2) from an earlier step (this line did it 3 times). A tip that has touched one liquid leaves a little of it in the next liquid it touches, so this stock now holds material that does not belong there. The protocol drew from it again afterwards, but only into wells that were given that material on purpose anyway, so this run is not harmed. What is left in the stock is no longer clean for the next run.
findings.fix: Pick up a fresh tip before line 97 goes into the stock. Or change the order: hand out the shared liquid first, while the tip is still clean, and add the other liquids afterwards with a fresh tip each.
